name: sokiva-web
description: SOKIVA marketplace frontend and trusted Firebase backend.

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-static-site.mjs && node scripts/validate-hardening-v2.mjs && node scripts/validate-audit-stack.mjs && node scripts/validate-tracking-stack.mjs && node scripts/validate-notification-stack.mjs && node scripts/validate-identity-stack.mjs && node scripts/validate-admin-control-center.mjs && node scripts/validate-support-operations.mjs && node scripts/validate-risk-operations.mjs && node scripts/validate-system-health.mjs && node scripts/validate-campaign-operations.mjs && node scripts/validate-admin-governance.mjs && node scripts/validate-operational-intelligence.mjs && node scripts/test-catalog-runtime.mjs && node scripts/validate-deploy-pipeline.mjs
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions install --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix functions test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project sokiva-rules-test --only database "npm --prefix functions run test:rules"
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:functions
